updates.problem: A permanently immutable parent evaluator cannot itself authorize a legitimate protected-input security upgrade, while simply weakening the checker destroys the trust root.
updates.target: Formalize one-time migration packets that freeze exact old/new protected inputs, external authorization, positive security meta-QoI, candidate execution, incumbent expected rejection, post-migration baseline re-freeze and supersession history.
updates.falsifier: If standard signed policy/review mechanisms already provide all required trust-root migration guarantees at lower complexity, map to them rather than inventing a RAKL-specific governance protocol.

updates.problem: Pinning action commits does not freeze `ubuntu-latest` or the hosted runner image/toolchain, which remain transitive evaluator dependencies.
updates.target: Freeze known-answer worlds comparing mutable runner labels, observed runner image versions/digests when available, containerized/hermetic evaluation and reproducible environment specifications; choose the minimum mechanism that materially improves evaluator reproducibility.
updates.falsifier: If hosted runner image drift does not affect registered evaluator outcomes and exact run metadata is sufficient for replay/audit, record observation rather than over-engineering a hermetic runner.
